Air India Turbulence Incident: Injuries, Misinformation, and Investigations

An Air India flight from Phuket to Delhi experienced severe turbulence, resulting in injuries to 17 passengers and 4 crew members. Some crew members required hospitalization. The incident has led to widespread misinformation and blame directed at the airline on social media. Aviation experts are explaining the causes of turbulence and addressing passenger fears. The Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) is investigating the incident, with reports indicating the pilot may have failed a dope test. Most injured passengers have been discharged.
